description: Deployment-level settings for the Logistay invoice generator: which procured KSA/ZATCA e-invoice app fills the inv_zatca_* fields, and which stock statutory VAT template applies. NAMES the procurement choice as an enum; the actual choice is a deployment decision (no default committed). No AFMCO value is stored here.

fields.description: Master switch. When OFF, no ZATCA stamping is attempted and inv_zatca_* stay blank.
fields.label: Enable ZATCA Stamping

fields.description: Which procured KSA e-invoice app fills the Sales Invoice inv_zatca_* fields. Procurement enum only (no default); the app choice is a deployment decision, seeded out-of-repo. custom code NEVER writes these values.
fields.label: ZATCA Connector App

fields.description: ZATCA e-invoicing phase the connector targets (public statutory phases).
fields.label: ZATCA Phase

fields.description: The stock ERPNext Sales Taxes and Charges Template that carries the statutory 15% VAT rate. Named here; the specific template is selected per deployment (no default).
fields.label: Statutory VAT Template

name: Logistay Invoice Settings
